English: A simple hand-pushed roller that compacts dirt into roads — no engine required, just determination.

German: Eine einfache handgeschobene Walze, die Erde zu Straßen verdichtet — kein Motor nötig, nur Entschlossenheit.

English: A primitive reel mower that cuts grass with nothing but muscle power. Slow but available long before modern machinery.
